genre_archetype: farm-to-market stall pricing and customer-flow management
camera_perspective: fixed orthographic split workspace with upper garden plots and lower front-facing market stall
control_model: single-touch tap, drag-to-stock, and tap-to-cycle price tiers
core_loop_signature: plant crops, time harvests, stock stall shelves, adjust price tiers, satisfy customer demand, earn coins and reputation, upgrade market capacity
differentiation_axes: primary pressure is live market selling rather than static crop orders
customer price tolerance and preferences determine success
reputation and revenue targets must both be managed
perishable produce creates timing risk after harvest
forbidden_template_reuse: do not reuse Bloom Orchard's timed orchard grid plus rotating order board as the main loop
do not reuse Petal Isle Farm's flower beauty score structure
do not reuse Pasture Parade Deluxe's animal pen collection and cleanliness loop
do not reduce the design to generic crop timers with one sell button
do not use a repeated three-pill top HUD and bottom command strip as the main layout

map_content_budget.play_area_model: one integrated market screen split into garden zone, stall workbench, customer queue, seed tray, storage crate, and chalkboard HUD
map_content_budget.route_or_region_count: at least 6 interactive regions: garden grid, seed tray, storage crate, three stall shelves, customer queue, and forecast sign
map_content_budget.interactive_regions: 12 crop plots, 3 stall shelves, 1 storage crate, 1 seed tray drawer, 1 customer queue lane, 1 daily forecast sign
map_content_budget.decorative_prop_count: at least 10 distinct props across crates, signs, awning folds, baskets, seed packets, and small market decorations
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: fixed landscape camera for the first delivery with no scrolling and no hidden interaction zones

player_unit_types: farmer cursor represented by touch actions rather than a moving avatar
enemy_types: no hostile enemies; customer pressure replaces combat

primary_player_actions: drag produce from storage to shelves
special_rules: perishable goods lose value after being stored too long
price tiers affect conversion and reputation
special orders grant star rating bonuses
risk_reward_systems: premium pricing yields more coins but risks complaints
fast crops are reliable but low margin
premium crops can miss demand timing
overstocking one product can cause lost opportunity

primary_game_art_packs: market stall and shop prop pack
secondary_game_art_packs: UI Kit cartoon light market motifs
simple harvest and coin effect sprites
asset_variety_budget.animation_tier: medium for customers, staged crop growth for crops, simple effect animation for sale feedback
asset_variety_budget.minimum_distinct_sprite_families: at least 6 crop families, 5 customer families, 4 market prop families, and 6 feedback effect families
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: reuse only style-matched farm, market, and customer assets with provenance; generic geometric placeholders are not acceptable for delivery-ready output
